item.title: A new open source journey: OBI
item.description:
Introduction 🔗

It’s been about a month since I joined the OBI project, and it already feels like one of those journeys where you learn something new every single day.

In this post, I’ll give a short introduction to what OBI is, walk through its project structure, show how you can try it out yourself, and share how to get involved. This won’t be a deep technical dive, you can think of it as a friendly overview to get familiar with the project and see it in action for the first time.

item.title: Crownlabs
item.description:
👨‍💻 CrownLabs: Remote Computing Labs 🔗

CrownLabs is a set of services designed to deliver remote computing labs through per-user environments based on:

  • Virtual machines (VMs)
  • Lightweight containers

This service was set up in about three weeks by a group of MSc students from the Polytechnic Institute of Turin (Italy) under the pressure of COVID-19 in March 2020.

CrownLabs is currently developed, maintained, and operated by a group of volunteers, mainly MSc students in Computer Engineering at the Polytechnic of Turin.
